house_style: Painted realistic editorial illustration for a senior high school energy control-room simulator. Rich matte gouache textures, precise industrial architecture, cinematic depth with foreground, middle ground and distance, directional light from upper left. Refined navy, amber and natural landscape colors. No people, text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.

assets.name: go-wind
assets.prompt: A line of tall white three-bladed utility-scale wind turbines along a grassy ridge, seen from a low hill at a distance. A low oak branch and textured grasses frame the foreground; access tracks, nacelles and tower bases define the middle ground; a blue lake and layered hills recede beyond. Clear afternoon light from upper left, white cumulus clouds, painted realistic editorial gouache, wide view. All turbines have exactly three blades connected to one hub. No industrial plant, people, text, letters, numbers or logos.
